from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "temp_sink") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "status_vendor") |> last()

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_idle" and r.cpu == "cpu-total") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 100.0 - r._value })) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Pi Power Consumption (not yet instrumented)
panels.description: No power sensor is wired up yet. Add an INA219/INA260 I2C HAT and a reader script following the same inputs.exec pattern used for the inverter poll, then point this panel at the new field.

targets.query: from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "upsd" and r._field == "battery_charge_percent") |> last()

panels.title: UPS Status
panels.description: Telegraf's upsd plugin models status as a separate tag per active NUT flag (status_OL / status_OB), present only while that flag is active — confirmed empirically by unplugging the UPS during testing, since the docs' description didn't match actual output. This query unions the last known-OL point and last known-OB point and keeps whichever is more recent, so it reflects true current status even though the underlying time range may contain both a past 'on line' period and a past 'on battery' period. Only OL/OB are tracked; other NUT flags (LB, HB, RB, etc.) aren't — extend the same pattern (a third unioned branch) if needed.

targets.query:
ol = from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "upsd" and r._field == "battery_charge_percent" and exists r.status_OL) |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: "On Line" }))
ob = from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "upsd" and r._field == "battery_charge_percent" and exists r.status_OB) |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: "On Battery" }))

union(tables: [ol, ob]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 1)

panels.title: Cloud Cover vs. AC Power
panels.description: Model cloud cover is Open-Meteo at the house (15-minute HRRR-based values). Station cloud cover comes from the SKY_STATION airport ceilometer (or the model when it's stale): FEW 19%, SCT 44%, BKN 75%, OVC 100%.

targets.query: from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "ac_power") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_model" and r._field == "cloud_cover_pct") |> set(key: "_field", value: "model cloud cover") |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_obs" and r._field == "cloud_cover_pct") |> set(key: "_field", value: "station cloud cover") |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"]) |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Sunlight vs. AC Power
panels.description: Open-Meteo modelled irradiance at the house. 'on panels' (GTI) uses PANEL_TILT / PANEL_AZIMUTH from .env; 'horizontal' is GHI. AC power falling well below the GTI curve on a clear day points at soiling, shading or an inverter issue.

targets.query: from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "ac_power") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_model" and (r._field == "gti_wm2" or r._field == "ghi_wm2")) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "gti_wm2" then "sunlight on panels" else "sunlight horizontal" })) |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"]) |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_obs" and r._field == "temp_f") |> set(key: "_field", value: "outside") |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"]) |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "temp_sink") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Direction is where the wind comes from (0/360 = north, 90 = east), drawn as points on the right axis. No direction is logged in calm air.

targets.query: from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_obs" and (r._field == "wind_mph" or r._field == "wind_gust_mph" or r._field == "wind_dir_deg")) |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"]) |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_obs" and r._field == "conditions") |> set(key: "_field", value: "conditions") |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"]) |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Weather Station Used
panels.description: Which station supplied the measurements (temperature, humidity, wind), and which supplied the sky fields (conditions, cloud cover, visibility). 'model' means Open-Meteo filled in because no station had a fresh reading.

targets.query: from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_obs" and r._field == "obs_age_min") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "measurements", _value: r.station + " (" + r.source + ")" })) |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "solar_logging") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_obs" and r._field == "obs_age_min") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "sky", _value: r.sky_station })) |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
